exposure: one-step screening for gestational diabetes (IADPSG criteria)
two-step screening for gestational diabetes (ACOG recommendation)
cohort: 1000 pregnant women screened for gestational diabetes mellitus
finding: The incidence of GDM was almost double using the one-step (IADPSG) approach compared to the two-step (ACOG) approach (19.2% vs 11.8%).
